title: 3738. Longest Non-Decreasing Subarray After Replacing at Most One Element

examples.explanation: Replacing nums[3] = 1 with 3 gives the array [1, 2, 3, 3, 2]. The longest non-decreasing subarray is [1, 2, 3, 3], which has a length of 4.
All elements in nums are equal, so it is already non-decreasing and the entire nums forms a subarray of length 5.
